# CapturePort

CapturePort is an offline-first AI-assisted field reporting application designed for engineers, inspectors, surveyors, technicians, marine service teams, and field operations.

Website: https://captureport.app
Support: support@captureport.app

Core capabilities:
- Offline field reporting
- Inspection reporting
- Photo-based reporting
- AI-assisted report drafting
- Voice notes and observations
- Mobile-first workflows
- Marine and industrial reporting workflows

CapturePort helps users capture field evidence, organize observations, and generate structured professional report drafts.

Target users:
- Marine engineers
- Service engineers
- Inspectors
- Surveyors
- Repair teams
- Offshore teams
- Field technicians
- Industrial service companies

Key pages:
- https://captureport.app/
- https://captureport.app/field-reporting-app/
- https://captureport.app/offline-reporting-app/

## Guides and resources

CapturePort publishes practical inspection reporting guides for field professionals:

- https://captureport.app/guides/how-to-write-vessel-inspection-report/
- https://captureport.app/guides/how-to-write-site-inspection-report/
- https://captureport.app/guides/how-to-write-mep-inspection-report/
- https://captureport.app/guides/how-to-write-property-snagging-report/

These guides cover marine vessel inspection reports, construction site inspection reports, MEP/HVAC/AMC inspection reports, and property snagging reports.
